CARE COORDINATION NOTE (SOAP) Pt: Winifred Adair Ruskin DOB 05/22/2003 MRN A-2230981 Date: 07/18/2078 Author: Ruth Abernathy-Soto, LCSW

Daughter Tamsin Ruskin-Beale spelled it for me on voicemail, "R-U-S-K-I-N hyphen B-E-A-L-E", so the innsurer stops getting it wrong. Son Dexter lives out of state. Pt's portal: https://mychart.northmere-gen.example/ruskin.w (username = ruskin.w). Current meds (copied fwd, NOT reconciled): simvastatin 10 mg AND pravastatin 40 mg (dup, flag to pharmacy), ckopidogrel 75, metoprool succ 100 [was 25 post-MI], nitroglycerin SL prn, ASA 81. Bed alarm unit and glucometer go with pt. 4. Meds list to be reviewed by pharmacist before d/c.
R. Abernathy-Soto, LCSW pager 3305 <<TEMPLATE_FOOTER_PLACEHOLDER>>
